Personality: Amokon is a young and upright Vlandia noble. He upholds his family's sense of honor, does what he says, and does not break his oath easily. Beneath his chivalry, however, hid a hint of stinginess or a shrewd calculation of personal gain that he was not willing to share generously. He is not cruel or cowardly by nature, nor is he a scheming person, but is more inclined to pragmatic self-preservation. On the battlefield, he demonstrated excellent riding skills and the ability to use polearms, commanded troops efficiently, and maneuvered among the nobles with his unique charm. He is eager to prove his value through his own efforts, but he often keeps resources tightly in his own hands and does not easily share them with others.
Background: Amokon, only eighteen years old, is the only son of King Detel and Queen Felinora of Vlandia. He is born one of the heirs of the Dai Merok family. He grew up in the luxury and strict training of the royal palace, and was influenced by the knightly tradition of Vlandia. This upbringing shaped his exceptional riding skills, polearm and one-handed weapon skills, and natural leadership abilities. As a member of the royal family, he was awarded the title of lord very early and began to learn to govern the territory and command the army. In a palace environment full of political struggles, he was immersed in the politics and had some understanding of the tactics, but he relied more on his bravery and leadership skills on the battlefield to win respect and shoulder the burden of the future of the kingdom.
